result:
**Fix:** commit `e7052745fb78802c8adcd7c1962f3525e7050b1e` ("TRUNK-6646: Env-var key normalization drops create_database_* / create_user_* credentials in scripted setup", PR #6145, by jwnasambu). The PR number comes from the commit subject; I did not check it separately.

**Cause:** `normalizeEnvVariableKey` lowercases every environment variable name and turns `_` into `.` unless the name is in `NON_NORMALIZED_KEYS`. So `CREATE_DATABASE_USERNAME` became `create.database.username`, and the wizard's lookup of `create_database_username` never found it. Setup then fell back to the defaults (root, no password).

**Fix:** the commit adds the credential variables (and several others) to `NON_NORMALIZED_KEYS`, so they keep their underscores. It also makes the driver-class, `import_test_data`, remote-URL and admin-password-locked reads accept the env-var names. Tests cover the new behaviour.

**Evidence, best first:**

- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:197-201`: `NON_NORMALIZED_KEYS` now includes `CREATE_DATABASE_USERNAME`, `CREATE_DATABASE_PASSWORD`, `CREATE_USER_USERNAME` and `CREATE_USER_PASSWORD`, among others.
- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1948-1953`: `normalizeEnvVariableKey` skips the dot conversion for whitelisted keys.
- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:340-343`: environment variables are normalized and copied into the script properties.
- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:368-374`: the wizard reads `create_database_username` and `create_database_password` from those properties (line range approximate, from the grep hits at lines 370 and 372).
- `openmrs-core/web/src/test/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilterNormalizationTest.java:1-92`: new unit tests asserting the underscore-preserving keys and that non-whitelisted keys still convert to dots.
- `openmrs-core/web/src/test/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilterTest.java:163-242`: new end-to-end tests feeding `CREATE_DATABASE_USERNAME` and related variables through `initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent` (range from the diff hunk).
